description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Irelia''' assumes a defensive stance with her blades to [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|charge]] for up to 1.5 seconds, during which she reduces incoming physical damage by 40% – 70% (based on level) (+ 8% per 100 AP) and incoming magic damage by 20% – 35% (based on level) (+ 4% per 100 AP). Additionally, ''Defiant Dance's'' damage increases over the first 0.75 seconds of the channel.
description.text: Active: Irelia assumes a defensive stance with her blades to charge for up to 1.5 seconds, during which she reduces incoming physical damage by 40% – 70% (based on level) (+ 8% per 100 AP) and incoming magic damage by 20% – 35% (based on level) (+ 4% per 100 AP). Additionally, Defiant Dance's damage increases over the first 0.75 seconds of the channel.

description2.raw: ''Defiant Dance'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Defiant Dance's'' charge cannot be [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]] by [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]].
description2.text: Defiant Dance can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. Defiant Dance's charge cannot be interrupted by crowd control.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Irelia''' swipes her blades in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies around her and within a line, increased by 0% – 200% (based on channel time). She also retains the damage reduction for 0.5 seconds.
description3.text: Recast: Irelia swipes her blades in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies around her and within a line, increased by 0% – 200% (based on channel time). She also retains the damage reduction for 0.5 seconds.

description4.raw: ''Defiant Dance's recast can be used while affected by [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disrupting|An icon representing the keyword Cast-inhibiting crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disrupting|cast-inhibiting crowd control]]. [[File:Irelia Ionian Fervor.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Ionian Fervor|An icon for Irelia's ability Ionian Fervor]] [[Irelia#Ionian Fervor|Ionian Fervor's]] duration is paused during the charge; if [[File:Irelia Ionian Fervor.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Ionian Fervor|An icon for Irelia's ability Ionian Fervor]] [[Irelia#Ionian Fervor|Ionian Fervor]] has less than 1 second remaining when the charge starts, it is set to 1 second when the charge ends.''
description4.text: Defiant Dance's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control. Ionian Fervor's duration is paused during the charge; if Ionian Fervor has less than 1 second remaining when the charge starts, it is set to 1 second when the charge ends.

Defiant Dance reaches 100% physical damage reduction at 857.14 – 428.57 (based on level) AP.
Defiant Dance reaches 100% magic damage reduction at 2285.71 – 1857.14 (based on level) AP.
Defiant Dance will also recast automatically upon entering resurrection.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
